title: ICSI Releases E-Admit Card for CSEET October 2026 Examination!
content:
# ICSI Releases E-Admit Card for CSEET October 2026 Examination!

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) October 2026 Examination ke liye E-Admit Cards announce kiye hain. This is a crucial step for all candidates preparing for the upcoming exams.

Here are the key details you need to know:

*   **Admit Card Release Date:** The E-Admit Cards were released on September 21, 2026.
*   **How to Download:** Candidates can download their admit cards from the official ICSI website. You will need your 17-digit Registration Number (Unique ID) and Date of Birth to log in and access your hall ticket.
*   **Examination Dates:** The CSEET October 2026 Examination is scheduled to be conducted on October 1, 3, 5, and 7, 2026.
*   **Mode of Examination:** The examination will be held in offline, centre-based mode.
*   **Mandatory Requirement:** It is compulsory to carry a printout of your admit card to the examination centre. Entry without a valid admit card will not be allowed.
*   **Verification:** Candidates are advised to carefully check all the details mentioned on their admit card, such as their name, registration number, exam date, time, and venue.
